[[Aloe Husk]] is a monk foe found in pre-Searing Ascalon. They never attack, even in retaliation. They are often seen in Green Hills County with the more fragile [[Aloe Seed]]s.

==Notes==
* Similarly to [[Oakheart (Ascalon)|Oakheart]]s, they only use Healing Breeze when affected by [[health degeneration]]
* They only cast Shielding Hands between roughly 10 and 40 health.
* Aloe Husks have 50 [[health]].
* They have no natural health regeneration.
